decision_rule: if p_cal[malignant] >= malignant_threshold -> flag malignant; elif max(p_cal) < uncertain_threshold -> "uncertain, see a doctor"; else argmax
note: Thresholds were chosen on the validation set; re-check per-skin-tone recall before shipping. malignant_suspect is an aggregate class (melanoma + selected malignant diagnoses), not melanoma-only. other_condition (if present) means "looks like something outside the targeted conditions", NOT "harmless".
